apps.name: Character Colors
apps.subtitle: Get any character's hex codes
apps.localizedDescription:
Makes any character into a ready-to-use color palette! Add a character from your photo library, paste an image, or search by name— the app automatically removes the background, finds the dominant colors, and hands you clean hex codes you can tap to copy.

Features
• Add characters from a photo or a search the web by name
• Automatic background removal so only the character's colors are detected
• Dominant-color extraction into a tidy hex palette, with copy-ready hex codes

versions.localizedDescription:
Hex Code Getter turns any character into a copy-ready color palette — automatically. It's all on one simple page: your character library, each entry showing clean #RRGGBB hex codes you can tap to copy.

What's included:
• Three ways to add — pick a photo from your library, search by name for a web image, or paste a Wikipedia article, and the app builds the palette for you.
• Automatic background removal — only the character's own colors are detected, not whatever was behind it.
• Dominant-color extraction — the key colors are pulled out and handed to you as copy-ready #RRGGBB hex codes.
• A searchable single-page library — everything you add lives in one place with its palette on the card; search to jump to any character, and edit to rename or remove.
• Fast, on-device color analysis — no accounts, no uploads.

More coming soon!

apps.name: Goose Clicker
apps.subtitle: The goose creates the value
apps.localizedDescription:
Goose Clicker is a simple idle game about one undervalued goose.

Tap the goose to produce eggs and grow your shareholder value!

versions.localizedDescription:
The goose has the value, not the eggs.

What's included:
• Tap to earn — every tap on the goose lays a golden egg and bumps your Shareholder Value by one, with a satisfying little "+1" that floats up off the bird.
• A one-time origin story — the first time you open the app, a short cutscene explains how it all began (spoiler: it began with 3 eggs).
• Springy, tactile feedback — the goose squishes and bounces on every tap, backed by sound and haptics you can mute anytime from the speaker button.
• Ever-rotating goose wisdom — a rotating cast of one-liners keeps the goose company at the bottom of the screen.
• Your progress is safe — Shareholder Value saves automatically and is right where you left it next time you open up.

Just you, the goose, and shareholder eggs. More is on the way.

apps.name: SoundLocks
apps.subtitle: Play a sound whenever your phone locks.
apps.localizedDescription:
SoundLocks plays a sound effect every time you lock your iPhone!

Pick from many built-in sounds or import your own. Leave the app running to play your chosen sound.

Features
• Fifteen built-in sound effects
• Use any sound effect of your choosing with a simple MP3 import
• One-tap preview to hear a sound before you pick it

Note: app must be open and running in the background to play the lock sound.

versions.localizedDescription:
Lock Screen Sound plays a sound effect every time you lock your phone. It's all on one simple page: your current sound front and center with a one-tap test, and the full sound list a tap away.

What's included:
• Three kinds of sounds — synthesized classic tones (Beep, Chime, Coin, Power Down, Alarm), ready-made effects (Level Up, Twinkle, Success), and some funny picks (Car Horn, Spring Jump, Explosion, Metal Pipe, Fah, Sus, Hello There).
• Tap to preview — every sound plays a sample the moment you select it, so you always know what you're setting.
• Bring your own — import any MP3 right from the app, then rename or remove it whenever you like.
• Pin your favorites — swipe to pin up to three sounds to the top of the list so they're always one tap away.
• A simple home screen — your current sound sits front and center; tap it to open the full list, or hit Test to hear it on demand.
• Always on, automatically — monitoring starts the moment you open the app; just keep it running in the background and it'll play your sound each time your phone locks.
